name: Level_2 - Task_7
description: Evaluate the volumetric thermal expansion coefficient (β) of bulk Aluminum between 300 K and 500 K using molecular dynamics. Use the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as the ASE-compatible calculator. Start with a conventional FCC unit cell of Aluminum (a = 4.05 Å) and replicate it into a 3 × 3 × 3 supercell. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the isothermal-isobaric (NPT) ensemble at target temperatures of 300 K, 400 K, and 500 K, and an external pressure of 1.01325 bar. For each temperature, equilibrate the system for 5,000 steps, followed by 10,000 production steps. Use an appropriate NPT integrator with a 1.0 fs timestep, a thermostat time constant of 25 fs, and a barostat factor of 2e6 GPa × fs². Record the instantaneous cell volume every 10 production steps to compute the average volume at each temperature. Use linear regression on the temperature-volume data to extract the volumetric thermal expansion coefficient. Return the resulting coefficient β as a floating-point value in K⁻¹.
